p.src: 106:1  For the accustomed security of the Quraysh[1],

ar: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ لِإِيلَـٰفِ قُرَيْشٍ
en: For the accustomed security of the Quraysh[1],
u.src: 106:1  For the accustomed security of the Quraysh[1],

en: [1] Allah had given Quraysh the honor of being guardians of the Holy Ka‘bah, which allowed them to travel in peace without fear of being harmed.

p.src: 106:2  secure in their winter and summer journeys[2].

en: secure in their winter and summer journeys[2].
u.src: 106:2  secure in their winter and summer journeys[2].

en: [2] i.e., their trading caravans would travel south to Yemen in winter and north to the Levant in summer.

p.src: 106:3  Let them worship the Lord of this [Sacred] House[3],

en: Let them worship the Lord of this [Sacred] House[3],
u.src: 106:3  Let them worship the Lord of this [Sacred] House[3],

p.src: 106:4  Who fed them against hunger and made them secure against fear[4].

ar: ٱلَّذِىٓ أَطْعَمَهُم مِّن جُوعٍ وَءَامَنَهُم مِّنْ خَوْفٍۭ
en: Who fed them against hunger and made them secure against fear[4].
u.src: 106:4  Who fed them against hunger and made them secure against fear[4].

en: [4] The people of Quraysh were blessed with provision and security probably because of the prayer of Abraham. See 14:35-37
